description: Figure: contact point II motif similarity of MRX20 to carriers of known substrate, with leave-one-out classifier accuracy
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
res = pd.read_csv("cp2_mrx20_ranking.tsv", sep="\t")
loo = pd.read_csv("cp2_loo_1nn.tsv", sep="\t")

COL = {"tricarboxylate":"#c0392b","dicarboxylate":"#e08214","oxodicarboxylate":"#2c7fb8",
       "nucleotide":"#7f8c8d","phosphate":"#7f8c8d","SAM":"#7f8c8d",
       "cationic aa":"#7f8c8d","acylcarnitine":"#7f8c8d"}
res = res.sort_values("score")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(13.5, 6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.35,1]})

a = ax[0]
a.barh(range(len(res)), res.score, color=[COL[c] for c in res.substrate_class], edgecolor="k", lw=.4)
a.set_yticks(range(len(res)))
a.set_yticklabels([f"{c}  {m}" for c, m in zip(res.carrier, res.motif)], fontsize=9, family="monospace")
a.set_xlabel("BLOSUM62 similarity to the MRX20 contact point II motif RQNQ")
a.set_title("MRX20 (R193, Q194, N197, Q201) against 16 carriers of known substrate", fontsize=10)
for i, (s, cl) in enumerate(zip(res.score, res.substrate_class)):
    a.text(s + .3, i, str(s), va="center", fontsize=8)
h = [plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,fc=COL[k],ec="k",lw=.4) for k in ["tricarboxylate","dicarboxylate","oxodicarboxylate"]]
h.append(plt.Rectangle((0,0),1,1,fc="#7f8c8d",ec="k",lw=.4))
a.legend(h, ["tricarboxylate","dicarboxylate","oxodicarboxylate","other substrate classes"],
         fontsize=8, loc="lower right", frameon=False)
a.set_xlim(-1, 21)

b = ax[1]
y = np.arange(len(loo))
b.barh(y, loo.best_score, color=[COL[c] for c in loo.true], edgecolor="k", lw=.4,
       hatch=["" if c else "///" for c in loo.correct])
b.set_yticks(y); b.set_yticklabels([f"{c}  {m}" for c, m in zip(loo.carrier, loo.motif)],
                                   fontsize=9, family="monospace")
b.invert_yaxis()
b.set_xlabel("score to nearest neighbour (leave-one-out)")
b.set_title("Leave-one-out 1-NN on the same motif: 9/11 correct\n"
            "(baseline 0.45, binomial p = 0.016); hatched = misclassified", fontsize=10)
for i, r in loo.iterrows():
    b.text(r.best_score + .3, i, ("→ " + r.pred) if not r.correct else "✓", va="center", fontsize=8)
b.set_xlim(0, 30)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
